acceptedAnswer.text: It is a structured form for evaluating candidates against predefined job-related criteria, typically including candidate information, evaluation categories, a rating scale, evidence notes and an overall recommendation.
Yes. Employers should adapt evaluation criteria to each role using the generator, adding or removing competencies and adjusting the rating scale as needed.

mainEntity.name: Should interviewers use the same scorecard?

acceptedAnswer.text: For comparable candidates applying to the same position, consistent criteria can improve evaluation clarity and make it easier to compare candidates fairly.

mainEntity.name: Does a high score guarantee candidate suitability?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Employers should consider the complete selection process and mandatory requirements rather than relying on a numerical score alone.
